EP25001.line: And we're underway at Old Trafford! Manchester United vs Liverpool.
Liverpool passing the ball around the back, probing for an opening.
Rashford makes a darting run, but the pass from Fernandes is just overhit.
GOAL! A stunning strike from Salah! He cuts inside and curls it into the top corner! 1-0 to Liverpool!
United look stunned. That came out of nowhere. The crowd is silenced.
Corner kick for United. Shaw to take it.
Cleared at the near post by Van Dijk.
YELLOW CARD! Casemiro goes into the book for a late challenge on Mac Allister.

LL25001.line: El Clásico is underway in Madrid! Simulating this scheduled match.
Bellingham and Gavi in an early midfield tussle.
GOAL! Real Madrid! Vinícius Jr. breaks free and slots it past the keeper!

BL25001.line: Kick-off in Munich for this completed match simulation.
And that's the full-time whistle! Bayern won 3-0.
